name: beamdesk
description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted remote desktop. Desktop app + browser client + self-hostable server.

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && npm run build -w server && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
